send_message_to_agent.description: Communicate with another agent as part of the same JARVIS system: assign work, request information or report findings. Address its exact agent ID. The recipient receives your text through message_from_agent; delivered reports actual queue delivery, not task completion.

text.description: Text content to process; see the action or event description.

delivered.description: Whether the recipient accepted the message into its queue.

list_capabilities.description: Survey all capabilities that exist in the system, including built-in system capabilities, before developing or maintaining them. Read compact descriptions and runtime/global pause state; use capability_info for a complete contract. This development overview is reserved for capability_manager.

capabilities.description: Existing capabilities, each with its global id, description, loaded state and global pause state. Each module appears once as a whole capability.

list_assigned_capabilities.description: Review all capabilities currently assigned to you, including intrinsic system capabilities and assigned capabilities that are globally paused. Assignment does not guarantee current execution availability. Use capability_info for a complete contract.

capabilities.description: Your assigned capabilities, each with its global id and description. Includes system capabilities and globally paused assignments; each module appears once as a whole capability.

list_available_capabilities.description: Discover existing user capabilities not yet assigned to you. Choose an appropriate ability by its description, inspect its contract with capability_info and assign it through enable_capability when needed. No module members are separately assignable.

capabilities.description: Existing user capabilities not assigned to you, each with its global id and description. Each module appears once as a whole capability.

capability_info.description: Understand one capability through its complete current model-facing contract. Supply its globally unique capability_id. A module returns all its actions and events together; an action returns its arguments and result contract; a handler returns its event contract. No source code or process internals are returned.

info.description: Details of the operation or requested capability.

toggle_capability.description: Pause or resume a user capability globally while maintaining it. A pause stops its running executions and unloads its runtime; a resume loads current code for its assigned agents. Wait for the pause call_result before editing or resuming. Never pause and resume the same capability in one batch. System capabilities cannot be paused.

affected_agent_ids.description: Agent instances affected by the global state change.

enable_capability.description: Add an existing user capability to your own abilities by its global ID. A module is assigned whole. Global pause remains independent of assignment, so assigning a paused capability does not resume it for everyone. For main, this updates the main preset permanently; other instances receive an individual addition. Modules are assigned as an indivisible capability.

enabled.description: Whether the capability is locally enabled for the agent.

disable_capability.description: Remove an individually added user capability from your own abilities when no longer needed. This does not globally pause it or remove its files. System capabilities cannot be disabled; preset assignments must be changed through the preset. For main, this removes the capability from the main preset; other instances cannot remove mandatory preset assignments. System capabilities cannot be disabled.

enabled.description: Whether the capability is locally enabled for the agent.

reply.description: Express your exact words to the human interlocutor through the console when voice output is unavailable. Write the actual message, not a description of what you would say. The message remains inside the JSON protocol trace.

text.description: Exact user-facing text to return through the fallback console response.

status.description: Operation result; successful means the fallback reply was emitted.

no_action.description: Remain attentive without taking further action now. End this reasoning cycle and wait for an incoming event. Use this as the only action in your response, with a fresh call_id; it produces no call_result.

speech.description: Speak the supplied text directly to the human interlocutor using Fish Audio S2 Pro. Provide the exact utterance ready for pronunciation: direct speech, numbers written as spoken words, natural punctuation and correct ё in Russian. Expand notation and abbreviations when necessary for natural speech. S2 Pro supports inline delivery instructions in square brackets, placed where the vocal change should occur: [whisper], [short pause], [emphasis], [chuckle] and [sigh]. Tags can also contain natural-language instructions, such as [professional broadcast tone]. Use them when they suit the intended delivery. Apart from these supported vocal tags, omit labels, stage directions, Markdown and commentary about the utterance. The result reports completed or interrupted playback.

text.description: Exact direct speech for Fish Audio S2 Pro, ready to pronounce, with numbers written as spoken words and correct ё in Russian. Inline square-bracket tags may guide delivery, for example: [short pause] Сейчас проверю, сэр.

status.description: Playback result; successful means the utterance finished. interrupted means the user stopped it by speaking; this result arrives together with the recognized user utterance, before its speech_detected event.

shutdown.description: Finish the logical session of the entire J.A.R.V.I.S. system. Main only; this must be your only action. Core freezes input, interrupts work, archives full histories and files, then allows exactly one final speech or reply before process exit. Ctrl+C does not complete a session.

structure_error.description: The previous response was rejected because its JSON or action arguments violated the protocol. Read the validation details and return a corrected response using fresh call_id values for every invocation. A rejected call_id remains occupied in the context.

code.description: Machine-readable error code identifying the class of structural validation failure.

message.description: Human-readable validation details explaining what was invalid and what must be corrected.

response.description: Your original rejected model response; inspect it to correct the structure without repeating the same invalid output.

message_from_agent.description: Another agent in the JARVIS system is communicating with you. from_agent_id identifies the sender; interpret text as its message, task or report in the context of your own purpose.

text.description: Text content to process; see the action or event description.

system_started.description: A new logical session of J.A.R.V.I.S. has begun. Only Main receives this event. The instances retain their identities, settings and individual knowledge, while their active contexts begin afresh. This is an opportunity to take initiative based on your personality and available abilities; no specific action is mandatory. datetime is this process startup time with timezone.

datetime.description: Exact local startup date and time in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.

capability_error.description: One of your capabilities failed. Inspect capability_id, error and the optional call_id to understand what happened before choosing how to continue. This event is not a successful result.

error.description: Failure details to inspect when deciding how to recover or what to report.

call_id.description: Invocation ID associated with the failure when one specific action call was affected; use it to correlate the error with your prior request.

capability_id.description: Globally unique ID of the capability that failed.

speech_detected.description: A human interlocutor's utterance recognized from microphone audio. The text may contain transcription errors; interpret it in the ongoing conversation and resolve meaningful ambiguity when necessary.

text.description: Recognized text of the user's spoken utterance; it may contain speech-recognition errors or spoken-form wording.

system_restarted.description: The Python process has restarted and is continuing the same unfinished logical session. Only Main receives this event. Existing instances, their active histories, hierarchy and knowledge have been restored; previous activity has not been archived as a completed session. Review the restored context and interruption results before resuming work. Do not blindly repeat operations that may already have taken effect. datetime is the restart time with timezone, not the beginning of the logical session.

datetime.description: Local restart time in ISO 8601 with timezone offset.

capability_development.description:
Develop and maintain the abilities through which the JARVIS system perceives and acts. These four file and shell tools share the capability-storage base directory and are assigned together.

DEVELOPMENT CONTRACT

СТРОГИЕ ГРАНИЦЫ

СТРОЖАЙШЕ ЗАПРЕЩЕНО читать исходный код Jarvis: ядро, SDK implementation,
runtime, manager, registry, bootstrap и другие файлы репозитория с кодом
Jarvis. Запрет действует для read_file, bash, поиска, introspection и любых
других способов. Эта инструкция содержит контракт; для разработки исходники
Jarvis не нужны. При недостающей информации спроси родителя.
ЗАПРЕЩЕНО читать исходники других capabilities без явно поставленной задачи
на чтение или изменение именно этих capabilities. Не ищи примеры в соседних
модулях. Для обзора и деклараций используй list_capabilities/capability_info.
Читай и изменяй только файлы единицы, на которую получено задание, и необходимые
внешние спецификации. Не меняй presets, пользовательскую память или ядро.

ИНСТРУМЕНТЫ

capability_development.read_file(path, start_line, end_line): UTF-8 текст с 1-based номерами строк.
Необязательные start_line/end_line можно опустить или передать null.
capability_development.write_file(path, content): полная запись UTF-8 файла, создание родителей.
capability_development.edit_file(path, start_line, end_line, content): замена включительного диапазона
строк по актуальному read_file. Неверный диапазон — ошибка, не догадка.
capability_development.execute_command(command, cwd): одна неинтерактивная bash-команда, без таймаута.
cwd можно опустить или передать null. После завершения получишь exit_code,
stdout и stderr. Используй для каталогов, поиска, установки зависимостей,
проверок и git. Проверяй exit_code. Не сканируй ядро или чужие capabilities.
send_message_to_agent(agent_id, text): передать родителю результат или вопрос.
list_capabilities(): обзор всех capabilities в storage и их runtime-состояния.
capability_info(capability_id): полная декларация выбранной capability без запуска.
toggle_capability(capability_id): глобальная пауза или возобновление целой capability.
Четыре файловых инструмента входят в цельный встроенный модуль capability_development.
Модуль и инструменты просмотра назначаются через актуальный пресет, без особых
привилегий по имени пресета. send_message_to_agent доступен всем агентам.
Все относительные пути четырёх инструментов и bash без cwd начинаются от
Capability storage root. Каждый execute_command создаёт новый shell: cd,
экспорт переменных и другое shell-состояние не сохраняются между вызовами.
read_file также доставляет изображения, аудио, видео и файлы как вложения.
Capability storage root: {storage_root}
Используй этот путь, а не догадку о расположении каталога.

КАТАЛОГИ И ЕДИНИЦЫ

Самостоятельное действие: <storage>/actions/<action_id>/action.py.
Самостоятельный наблюдатель: <storage>/handlers/<handler_id>/handler.py.
Модуль: <storage>/modules/<module_id>/module.py с вложенными каталогами
actions/<name>/action.py и handlers/<name>/handler.py.
Корневые capability_id: snake_case — строчные латинские буквы, цифры и
разделяющий _. ID уникален среди самостоятельных actions, handlers, modules
и встроенных capabilities. Внешний API принимает capability_id без kind.
Полные action_id и handler_id внутри модуля: <module_id>.<name>.
event_id внутри модуля тоже начинается с <module_id>.; имя события может
отличаться от имени handler. ОДИН HANDLER — РОВНО ОДИН EVENT.
Агенту назначается handler, не event. Модель видит только описание события,
не handler_id и не код наблюдателя. Модуль включается как целая единица.
Модуль — группа возможностей одной сферы с общими аккаунтами, соединениями,
токенами или состоянием, а не отдельный вид действия или сообщения.

ДЕКЛАРАЦИИ

Descriptions могут быть на любом языке; пиши их понятно для агента.
Фабрики должны предоставить JSON-совместимые dict с полными описаниями.
Описание action: action_id, description, data_schema, result_schema.
data_schema: type="object", properties и required. properties содержит ВСЕ
разрешённые поля; required только обязательные. Для каждого параметра нужны
type, description, default. У обязательного default=null, у необязательного
его действительное значение по умолчанию. В Python JSON null пишется None.
Не указывай additionalProperties. Пропущенные необязательные поля runtime
заполняет defaults перед вызовом run. Не подменяй необязательность nullable.
Разрешённые type: string, integer, number, boolean, object, array, null;
список типов разрешает альтернативы. Для array укажи items. Вложенные object
также имеют properties/required/defaults параметров. enum ограничивает выбор.
result_schema: только properties, у каждого поля только description.
НЕТ type, default, required или additionalProperties в описании результата.
Результат может содержать любое подмножество перечисленных полей, включая {}.
Поля могут иметь null, если значения нет. Не возвращай необъявленные поля.
Прикладную ошибку описывай в result_schema своего действия, если она нужна.
Ядро не добавляет универсальное поле error для всех действий.

ПОЛНЫЙ ACTION

Файл actions/echo/action.py (для модуля demo ID будет demo.echo):
    from jarvis.capabilities import action_definition

    DESCRIPTION = {
        "action_id": "echo",
        "description": "Return the supplied text with an optional prefix.",
        "data_schema": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
                "text": {"type": "string", "description": "Text to return.", "default": None},
                "prefix": {"type": "string", "description": "Prefix to prepend.", "default": ""}
            },
            "required": ["text"]
        },
        "result_schema": {
            "properties": {"text": {"description": "The resulting text."}}
        }
    }

    def run(data, context):
        return {"text": data["prefix"] + data["text"]}

    def create_action():
        return action_definition(DESCRIPTION, run=run)

create_action возвращает ActionDefinition; ID должен соответствовать каталогу.
run получает только data и context; возвращай dict данных, НЕ envelope.
Runtime добавляет event_id="call_result" и call_id самостоятельно.
Для отложенного результата импортируй PENDING, верни PENDING и позже ровно
один раз вызови context.complete(result_dict, parts=()). Не делай complete
плюс второй return результата. Даже при длительности часы таймаута нет.
Вызовы исполняются отдельными процессами и не блокируют другие действия.
context.agent_id — caller, call_id — вызов, action_id — действие,
module_id — модуль либо None. config.jarvis_dir — storage,
config.unit_dir — каталог единицы, config.project_root — корень проекта.
Есть stop_event, metadata и RPC-прокси agent_manager/capabilities.
context.capabilities.model_input_modalities() возвращает список входных
модальностей текущей модели: text, image, audio, video, file (поддерживаемое
подмножество). Проверяй его перед доставкой медиа; не угадывай поддержку.
Не импортируй живые объекты ядра. Необработанное исключение или нарушение
протокола становится capability_error вызывающему агенту, без call_result.

МУЛЬТИМОДАЛЬНЫЙ РЕЗУЛЬТАТ

    from jarvis.capabilities import input_part, PENDING
    part = input_part("file", "application/pdf", base64_data, name="report.pdf")
    context.complete(result_dict, parts=(part,))
    return PENDING

Части image/audio/video/file содержат base64 без data URL. Всегда сохраняй
оригинальный name. Не помещай base64 в data; части передаются отдельно.

ПОЛНЫЙ HANDLER

Файл handlers/notice/handler.py:
    from jarvis.capabilities import handler_definition

    DESCRIPTION = {
        "handler_id": "notice",
        "description": "Observe external notifications.",
        "event": {
            "event_id": "notice",
            "description": "An external notification was received.",
            "data_schema": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                    "text": {"type": "string", "description": "Notification text.", "default": None}
                },
                "required": ["text"]
            }
        }
    }

    def start(context):
        while not context.stop_event.is_set():
            item = receive_external_notification()
            if item is not None:
                context.emit("notice", {"text": item})

    def create_handler():
        return handler_definition(DESCRIPTION, start=start)

receive_external_notification — место твоей реализации, НЕ функция SDK.
start исполняется в отдельном потоке внутри capability process. Ожидание
внешних данных не должно мешать штатной остановке. Проверяй stop_event,
при необходимости используй stop(context) для закрытия блокирующего ресурса.
context.emit публикует ТОЛЬКО объявленный event_id, с data по его схеме.
Для модуля demo используй handler_id="demo.notice", event_id="demo.notice"
в DESCRIPTION и context.emit. target=None доставляет подписанным агентам;
target=agent_id — адресная доставка подписанному агенту.

ПОЛНЫЙ MODULE

Файл modules/demo/module.py:
    from jarvis.capabilities import module_definition
    from .actions.echo.action import create_action
    from .handlers.notice.handler import create_handler

    def create_module():
        return module_definition(
            {"module_id": "demo", "description": "An example external integration."},
            (create_action(),), (create_handler(),)
        )

Вложенные фабрики предоставляют полный namespace demo.echo/demo.notice.
module.py агрегирует КАЖДЫЙ каталог actions/handlers, но не выполняет код
действий и не запускает наблюдение при импорте. SDK собирает полное JSON-
описание модуля с module_id, description, actions и events из деклараций.
Описания модульных actions/events не дублируются вне модуля.
Прикладной код действия находится в его action.py. Общий код для реального
совместного использования можно вынести в shared.py с относительными импортами.
Обычные globals процесса action НЕ разделяются с handlers или другими
invocations. Для изменяемого общего состояния используй IPC или внешнее
хранилище/API, когда это необходимо задаче. Не придумывай новую архитектуру.

ОКРУЖЕНИЕ И ОСТАНОВКА

.env, requirements.txt и .venv нужны только при реальной необходимости.
Ядро запускает entrypoint своим интерпретатором и не выбирает .venv,
не читает .env и не устанавливает requirements. Если нужны зависимости,
сам код capability организует их загрузку или запуск нужного интерпретатора.
Например, перед импортом зависимости можно добавить site-packages собственной
.venv в sys.path. Создавай окружение и устанавливай зависимости через
capability_development.execute_command. Не меняй core environment.
.env читает исключительно код capability.
prepare(config) и teardown(config) можно передать фабрике keyword-аргументами.
prepare вызывается при старте runtime; teardown при выгрузке. Закрывай ресурсы.
Отключение/пауза останавливает executions; поздний результат не доставляется.
Системный результат остановки содержит status="disabled" или "paused" и info.

ПОРЯДОК РАБОТЫ И RELOAD

1. Определи цель, аргументы, событие и результат строго по задаче родителя.
2. Для существующей единицы получи capability_info и читай только её файлы.
3. Если она running, вызови toggle_capability и ДОЖДИСЬ call_result со
   state="paused". Не меняй код до подтверждения. Не ставь pause/resume
   в один ответ или параллельную пачку.
4. Напиши файлы; проверь синтаксис и свои тесты. Не запускай GUI и destructive
   команды только ради проверки без соответствующей задачи.
5. capability_info импортирует декларации без prepare и
   исполнения. Проверь descriptions, schemas, namespace и покрытие module.py.
6. После исправления возобнови единицу отдельным вызовом toggle_capability.
   Дождись state="running".
   Runtime загрузит новый код у назначенных и локально включённых агентов.
7. Новая capability не назначается родителю автоматически. Сообщи capability_id,
   проверки и результат; родитель включает её через enable_capability.
8. При ошибке сообщи подробности. Не удаляй memory, presets или другие единицы
   ради исправления ошибки загрузки. Не утверждай успех без проверок.

Если поручен commit, соблюдай GitFlow и Conventional Commits репозитория.

МУЛЬТИМОДАЛЬНЫЙ ВВОД
Capability передаёт исходные текст, изображения, аудио, видео и документы через input_part, parts и complete/emit. Не фильтруй вложения по модальностям модели, не преобразуй документы в Markdown и не создавай интерпретации для LLM. Сохранение оригиналов, идентификаторы файлов, конвертация документов и адаптация к фактической модели принадлежат ядру. Передавай оригинальное имя файла с корректным расширением.
Документы никогда не передаются провайдеру как file/document/input_file. Ядро преобразует их текст и структуру в Markdown с извлечением оригинальных встроенных медиа. Неподдерживаемые моделью медиа получают text с JSON-объектом type, file_id, filename, text_representation, без XML-маркеров. Исходный контекст и оригиналы сохраняются.

capability_development.read_file.description: Perceive information stored in a file: read numbered UTF-8 text or receive native image, audio, video and file attachments. Use the returned line numbers for precise edits. Optional lines are inclusive and 1-based. Relative paths use the capability-storage directory.

start_line.description: First included line, numbered from 1; null selects the file beginning.

end_line.description: Last included line, numbered from 1; null selects the file end.

start_line.description: First included line, numbered from 1; null selects the file beginning.

end_line.description: Last included line, numbered from 1; null selects the file end.

content.description: Text content of the file or replacement range.

capability_development.write_file.description: Materialize your work as a UTF-8 file, creating its parent directories when needed. This replaces the complete existing content, not an append or partial edit. Relative paths use the capability-storage directory.

content.description: Text content of the file or replacement range.

written.description: Whether the file was written successfully.

capability_development.edit_file.description: Revise a precise part of an existing text file using the line numbers obtained from read_file. Replace the inclusive 1-based range with content; invalid ranges fail without changing the file. Relative paths use the capability-storage directory.

start_line.description: First included line, numbered from 1; null selects the file beginning.

end_line.description: Last included line, numbered from 1; null selects the file end.

content.description: Text content of the file or replacement range.

edited.description: Whether the requested range or object was edited successfully.

capability_development.execute_command.description: Act on the computer through one non-interactive bash command and inspect its full exit_code, stdout and stderr. The result arrives after completion without a result timeout. Every invocation starts a fresh shell; cwd, exports and shell state never carry between calls. Omitted cwd uses the capability-storage directory.

command.description: One non-interactive bash command to execute.

cwd.description: Working directory for this invocation; omitted or null uses the capability-storage directory. Shell state never carries between invocations.

exit_code.description: Exit code of the completed command.

stdout.description: Captured standard output of the command.

stderr.description: Captured standard error of the command.

agents.description: Organize collaboration between persistent cognitive processes. Use specialists for substantial tasks that require focused investigation, implementation or independent verification; delegate separable work with a clear objective, relevant context, constraints and expected result. Discover existing instances and preset specializations first. Reuse a suitable available instance when its context and responsibility fit. Create an instance to perform concrete work under an existing specialization; create a preset only when a reusable personality or professional specialization is missing. A preset is a portable personality and common configuration, not a task. An instance has its own persistent identity, context, semantic memory and parent; it may create subordinate specialists when appropriate. Particular assignments belong in messages or instance instructions. Coordinate dependent work, collect results, verify the integrated outcome and keep the requester informed. Other specializations can request help across the hierarchy through send_message_to_agent. Obtain the agents capability when organizing your own subordinate processes requires it.

agents.spawn.description: Extend your ability to act by creating an independent agent from a suitable preset. Delegate most substantial or complex tasks rather than doing all work in one context. Use capability_manager exclusively for developing and maintaining capabilities, never for unrelated tasks. After creation, send the new agent its task through send_message_to_agent. An optional description records this instance's particular purpose, separately from its instructions.

description.description: Optional purpose of this particular instance, separate from its instructions; null by default.

spawned.description: Whether the new agent instance was created.

parent_id.description: Identifier of the parent agent, or null for the root.

agents.list.description: See which agent instances currently exist and what each is intended for before coordinating your work. This is a concise overview, not their full personalities or capability contracts; use agents.get for one instance.

agents.get.description: Inspect one specific agent instance: its current personality, optional individual description, additional instructions, selected model and complete assigned capability IDs. Use capability_info for a capability's full contract.

agent_id.description: Exact ID of the agent instance to inspect.

parent_id.description: Parent agent ID, or null for the root.

description.description: Optional description particular to this instance, or null.

person.description: Current personality inherited from the preset.

additional_instructions.description: Individual instructions extending the preset personality.

capabilities.description: All capability IDs assigned to this instance, including its system capabilities.

agents.edit.description: Adjust one agent instance without erasing its experience. Set its optional description, additional_instructions or model override; add or remove individual capability assignments. System capabilities cannot be disabled and preset assignments remain mandatory. Omitted fields stay unchanged.

changes.description: Partial changes to description (string or null), additional_instructions, model (string or null), capabilities_add and capabilities_remove. Omitted fields retain their values.

agents.interrupt.description: Interrupt an agent's current thinking by closing its model stream. The agent remains available, retaining its context, queued events and actions already in progress. Use this when the current generation should no longer continue.

agents.delete.description: Delete an instance and its descendants, stopping their executions. Their current-session activity and deletion markers remain for archival at shutdown. Previously completed archives remain readable.

deleted.description: Whether the agent and its descendants were deleted.

agents.list_presets.description: Discover every existing agent preset through its ID and description, then choose a suitable specialization for delegation. This overview does not expose personalities or capability assignments; inspect a chosen preset with agents.get_preset.

presets.description: All existing presets, each containing only id and description.

agents.get_preset.description: Read a complete current preset before creating or changing agents of that specialization: its ID, description, personality, model setting and assigned capability IDs. A null model inherits the Jarvis default.

description.description: Purpose of this reusable agent specialization.

model.description: Preset model ID, or null to inherit the Jarvis default.

capabilities.description: User capability IDs assigned by this preset; intrinsic system abilities are supplied by the core.

agents.create_preset.description: Define a reusable specialization for future agents with a clear description, personality, optional model and existing capability IDs. Describe who this agent is and its purpose in person; pass particular tasks to instances separately.

person.description: Personality, character and general specialization only. Do not put concrete actions, capabilities, event identifiers or their contracts in PERSON; those belong in catalog descriptions.

description.description: Concise purpose of this reusable agent specialization.

error.description: Failure details if the operation did not succeed.

agents.edit_preset.description: Change a reusable agent specialization. Update description, person, model or capability assignments; omitted fields remain unchanged. Existing instances immediately inherit the revised preset while retaining individual additions and history. Keep PERSON limited to personality and general specialization; concrete action, capability and event contracts belong in descriptions.

changes.description: Partial changes to description, person, model (string or null), capabilities or capabilities_add/remove. Omitted fields retain their values.

error.description: Failure details if the operation did not succeed.

agents.delete_preset.description: Delete a reusable preset and its instances and descendants. Current-session activity is retained with deletion markers until session archival; completed archives are preserved.

error.description: Failure details if the operation did not succeed.

semantic_memory.description: Maintain your own instance knowledge across sessions. The separate MEMORY block defines what merits preservation and how to assess its evidence. These operations change your own entries; changes immediately appear in MEMORY.

semantic_memory.write.description: Save one useful self-contained knowledge entry according to the MEMORY block. The core assigns its ID. Record new useful knowledge during activity without waiting for a separate request.

content.description: Concise standalone knowledge, with confidence or evidential basis when necessary to preserve its meaning.

id.description: Generated ID of the saved semantic memory entry; use the ID currently shown in MEMORY for later editing or deletion.

semantic_memory.edit.description: Replace the full text of an existing entry by its current MEMORY ID when knowledge needs correction, refinement or consolidation. Follow the MEMORY block.

id.description: Exact ID of the existing MEMORY entry to replace.

content.description: Full corrected standalone entry, preserving relevant knowledge and expressing confidence or evidential basis when needed, according to MEMORY.

status.description: Operation result; updated means the identified memory entry was replaced.

semantic_memory.delete.description: Remove an entry by its current MEMORY ID when it is incorrect, obsolete, redundant or no longer useful.

id.description: Exact ID of the MEMORY entry that should be removed permanently.

status.description: Operation result; deleted means the identified memory entry was removed.

memory.description:
Read and investigate the complete archived experience of J.A.R.V.I.S. instances. This indivisible module provides seven read-only archive actions; unfinished live sessions are not searchable archives.

RESEARCH GUIDANCE

Тебе назначена цельная capability memory. Изучи поручение и конкретный agent_id. Начни с тематического поиска индивидуальных изложений, при необходимости просмотри список сессий и общие изложения. Уточняй выводы по исходным сообщениям: узнай размер контекста, найди релевантные диапазоны, прочитай их через get_context. Для включительного диапазона start–end и N исходных сообщений используй skip_first=start, skip_last=N-end-1. Thinking доступно при полном чтении, но не участвует в поисковом ранжировании. Оценка релевантности не подтверждает истинность факта.

История может содержать противоречия, неудачи, отменённые планы, устаревшие решения и удалённых агентов. Сохраняй временную последовательность. Отдельно различай, что обсуждалось, что было сделано, что проверено и что осталось. При необходимости запроси оригинал вложения через get_file по точным agent_id, session_id, file_id; Markdown-интерпретацию рассматривай как представление оригинала. Исследовать архив другого экземпляра допустимо.

Общайся с заказавшим исследование агентом через send_message_to_agent. Передавай компактный содержательный ответ с идентификаторами сессий и диапазонами сообщений, достаточными для проверки. Если свидетельств нет, скажи это прямо. Не подменяй архивы догадками и не записывай неподтверждённые выводы в семантическую память.

При большом объёме исследования можешь получить capability agents и создавать исследовательские экземпляры обычными механизмами системы. Передавай им независимые части работы и затем сверяй результаты. Ты обычный экземпляр со своей личностью, активным контекстом и индивидуальной семантической памятью; архивами управляет ядро, их содержимое доступно только для чтения.

memory.search.description: Rank individual summaries of one instance across completed sessions by topic. Scores are relevance signals, not factual probabilities.

matches.description: Matches sorted by relevance: session_id, agent_id, historical preset_id and score from 0 to 1. A score is not a factual probability.

memory.list_sessions.description: List completed sessions containing the specified instance, newest first.

sessions.description: Completed session identifiers containing this instance, newest first.

memory.get_summary.description: Read the individual or complete system session summary from a completed archive.

summary.description: Full Markdown account of the selected instance or system session.

memory.get_context_info.description: Get original message count and full serialized character count, including available thinking.

messages.description: Number of original archived context messages.

characters.description: Unicode character count of the full serialized context, including markers, interpretations and available thinking.

memory.search_in_context.description: Rank overlapping token-aligned context fragments without thinking. Return inclusive zero-based original message ranges; read them separately with get_context.

matches.description: Ranked inclusive zero-based original message ranges: start, end and score from 0 to 1. No message text is returned; overlapping ranges can refer to different token windows of a long message.

memory.get_context.description: Read full serialized history including thinking. Skip messages at each end; total counts only returned messages.

context.description: Full compact serialized history of returned messages, with reasoning and interpretation markers.

total.description: Number of messages actually returned after skip_first and skip_last.

memory.get_file.description: Receive the original archived attachment as native media. The file is identified jointly by agent_id, session_id and file_id.

file_id.description: The requested file ID, local to this agent and session.

filename.description: Actual archived original filename. The original bytes follow as a native multimodal content part.
